MissionDescription: At Sambodhi Academy, our mission is to empower aspiring individuals with the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to excel in government service examinations. We are committed to providing high-quality education, personalized guidance, and comprehensive support to help our students achieve their career goals in public service.
VisionDescription: We envision a future where every ambitious individual has access to top-notch educational resources and mentorship to pursue a successful career in government services. Our goal is to be the leading institute in preparing competent and ethical civil servants who will contribute to the nation's progress and development.
AboutDescription: Sambodhi Academy operates competitive exam training centers across various cities in Maharashtra offering special concession to aspirants from backward classes and economically weaker sections. It is empaneled by autonomous government institutes like SARTHI, BARTI, TRTI and MAHAJYOTI. It’s state of the art infrastructure and focus on over all development has helped hundreds of aspirants secure positions in government and semi-government services including top ranks since 2010.
